title: Nonsofic wreath products of residually finite groups
summary: This work builds on the breakthrough of OpenAI in finding the first nonsofic group. We analyze the underlying proof mechanism and find further applications. Let $Γ<G$ be such that $\{g\in G:gΓg^{-1}\leqΓ\}$ generates $G$ as a group, and suppose that both $Γ$ and $G$ have property $(T)$. If $Γ$ is not normal, then the generalized wreath product $\bigl(\bigoplus_{G/Γ}\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z\bigr)\rtimes G$ and the group double $G \ast_Γ G$ are nonsofic.
